checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: Slots 1,2,3,4 (mag module),5,6 (tempdeck),7,9,10,11 and both pipettes match; temp_mod.set_temperature(4) was run, and the check elution_plate_4C_before_recovery passed.

The checks 48_samples_to_odd_columns, fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact (48 distinct tips) and distinct_elution_wells passed. Sample n maps to a fixed well, and each eluate goes to the matching elution-plate position.

Beads 40 uL, then isopropanol 250 uL, then sample 250 uL, followed by p1000.mix(5,300) and a 5 min delay before the magnet; checks binding_volumes_40_250_250, mix_5x_after_sample and incubation_5min_before_magnet passed.

mag_mod.engage() then a 4 min delay, then 540 uL removed in 180 uL aliquots at 0.8 mm height and a slow 40 uL/s aspirate; checks magnet_4min_before_first_removal and magnet_engaged_for_all_removals passed.
Two 500 uL ethanol additions, each followed by 510 uL removal with the magnet engaged; two_500ul_ethanol_washes and supernatant_removed_each_step passed.
A 4 min delay follows the last wash removal, then mag_mod.disengage() before elution; air_dry_4min passed.

100 uL elution is added off-magnet and mixed 10x. The magnet is engaged after 30 s and held for 90 s. The code recovers the full 100 uL (m300.aspirate(ELUTION_VOL)) rather than ~80 uL, which risks carrying over beads or air.

Volumes are split to fit the 200 uL tips (200/200/100 for ethanol, 180 uL plus air gap for removals). About 34 multi-channel tips and 48 p1000 tips are used, within the racks. Heights and flow rates are sensible, and the simulation passed.
Steps follow the paper's order 1-9 with the correct reagents and 70% ethanol. The only addition is a bead-stock pre-mix, which is harmless, and the metadata and comments are accurate.

judge.summary: The protocol passed all 16 measured checks and matches the paper's step order, volumes and timings for all 48 samples. The one shortfall is that it recovers the full 100 uL of eluate rather than ~80 uL, so elution_recovery gets 0.5 and every other item scores 1.
